title: Add up 1 to n
promptMd: Read a non-negative integer `n` and print `1 + 2 + … + n` (print `0` when `n` is 0). Use a loop — that's the point of this exercise.

requiredPatterns.message: Use a loop to add the numbers one at a time.

hints: You need a running total that starts at 0.
The loop variable should take every value from 1 up to and including n.
If n is 0 the loop should not run at all — check your loop condition.
